deck_title: Blinn screen-space reciprocal depth 1/z interpolation vs naive linear view-z hyperbolic bowing rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Jim Blinn (IEEE CG&A 1992) & Heckbert-Moreton (1991) screen-space reciprocal depth interpolation (1/z(t) = (1-t)/z_0 + t/z_1, giving harmonic mean z(0.50) = 1.8000 m for a slanted plane from z_0 = 1.0 m to z_1 = 9.0 m and locking depth accuracy ratio R = 1.0000x across all 17 screen stations) versus naive screen-space linear view-depth interpolation (z_linear(t) = (1-t)z_0 + t z_1, which gives arithmetic mean 5.0000 m at t=0.50 and inflates depth by up to 2.7778x / +177.78% across all 15/17 interior stations) and 64-step 3D camera ray-plane intersection.
